##### Project general facts

Creek View by Iraz Properties is a contemporary waterfront development in Al Jaddaf, designed to combine modern architecture with a calm, urban lifestyle. The mid-rise structure features a well-balanced composition of clean lines, glass elements, and functional design, rising across multiple residential levels above dedicated parking and a ground-floor entrance. A curated selection of studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive penthouses, is thoughtfully planned to maximize space, natural light, and panoramic canal views, creating a refined and comfortable living environment.

The lifestyle at Creek View is centered around relaxation, convenience, and everyday well-being. Residents enjoy access to a range of amenities including a swimming pool, fully equipped fitness center, and a rooftop retreat that offers open views and a peaceful atmosphere. Landscaped communal areas and carefully designed shared spaces create a sense of community, while 24/7 security and smart infrastructure ensure comfort and peace of mind. The project delivers a balanced living experience where leisure and practicality come together seamlessly.

Interiors are finished with high-quality materials, including porcelain flooring and contemporary detailing, complemented by integrated smart home systems. Kitchens come fully equipped with premium Bosch appliances, custom cabinetry, and Italian countertops, while bathrooms feature high-end sanitary ware from brands such as Grohe and Duravit. Residences are offered unfurnished, allowing for personalization while maintaining a sophisticated, modern foundation.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jaddaf, situated in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, is a dynamic and culturally rich district that seamlessly integrates elements of culture, commerce, and leisure. This area holds cultural significance, boasting a plethora of museums, art galleries, and cultural centers that pay tribute to local and international heritage. Among these, the Dubai Culture Village stands out as a vibrant hub for artistic expression and creative exploration.

With its picturesque location along the Dubai Creek, Al Jaddaf offers stunning waterfront views. It has witnessed significant development, welcoming luxury hotels and contemporary residential complexes that provide captivating vistas of the Dubai Creek.

Al Jaddaf also caters to leisure and recreation, with well-maintained parks and open spaces for residents and visitors to enjoy outdoor activities. The presence of diverse restaurants and cafes adds to its charm, making it a delightful destination for relaxation and dining.
